repo_meta_data.description: git-wt is a Zsh-native plugin that provides a safe, predictable and completion-first workflow for managing Git worktrees in your shell. It offers explicit commands to create, switch, list and remove feature worktrees, with first-class tab completion and a minimal, deterministic command set.
